title: TA CR THETA 2 - 4th Public Competition, PP1-PP3
summary: Applications close on 21 October 2026 at 16:29:59 CEST. PP1 has CZK 120 million allocated, up to CZK 15 million per project and 90% whole-project support; PP2 has CZK 500 million and 60%; PP3 has CZK 550 million and 85%. No project ceiling is specified for PP2/PP3, which does not mean unlimited funds. PP1/PP2 run 12-48 months and PP3 36-56 months, with starts in May-July 2027.
reality_check: UJF may lead subject to the subprogramme rules. A research organisation's non-economic activities may receive 100%, but the whole-project rate still applies. PP1 requires an external application guarantor; PP2 requires an enterprise to use the results. Demonstrate an energy-sector outcome, not general thematic similarity. Use the PP1 objective on industrial electrification revised on 7 September.
action_note: For PP1 using SUJB as guarantor, the separate one-calendar-month rule from the 26 August announcement gives 26 September; submission by Friday 25 September is recommended. Confirm the procedure and do not assume a weekend extension. This is not the TA CR final deadline. Build participant-level financing and a concrete application plan.

Standard indirect-cost rules or full cost apply as specified in the national conditions; the time-zone wording in source documents was inconsistent.

action_note: Match a concrete UJF contribution to a Czech-funded module, confirm the consortium and prepare each Czech participant's national annexes alongside the international pre-proposal.

action_note: Agree a concrete diagnostics, sensor or component-qualification task with fusion-system and industrial partners, then establish the UJF budget and technology readiness.

summary: The 2027 work programme plans opening on 12 November 2026, with deadlines on 10 March and 16 September 2027. The overall allocation is EUR 60 million; this scan did not separately verify the amount per project.
reality_check: Only eligible previous ERC grant holders with a related ERC result can use this route. It is not a general technology-transfer call for all UJF teams.
action_note: Check the originating ERC grant, PI, end date and rights to the result before selecting a submission deadline.

title: Horizon Europe Hop-on Facility 2026
summary: HORIZON-WIDERA-2026-03-WIDENING-01 closes on 24 September 2026 at 17:00 CEST. It adds a new research work package and widening partner to an eligible running Pillar II or EIC Pathfinder project. Expected additional contribution: EUR 0.2-0.6 million, at least 90% for the new partner and at most 10% for coordination.
reality_check: The target grant must meet the call's no-existing-widening-participant conditions, including the specified affiliated or associated roles. It must be 1-12 months from the project start, still in its first reporting period. The existing coordinator submits with consortium agreement; this is not top-up funding for an existing UJF participation.
action_note: Complete only an already negotiated accession. Verify the grant ID, every participant, project start date and reporting period with the coordinator before submission.

title: Research Management Facility 2026
summary: HORIZON-WIDERA-2026-04-WIDENING-01 closes on 24 September 2026. The expected EUR 7 million contribution is for a European facility delivering needs assessment, training and implementation plans, not a local grant-office allocation.
reality_check: Requires a widening coordinator and at least three independent entities in three EU/associated countries, including two EU countries. The facility supports assessment and planning, not implementation of institutional strategies themselves.
action_note: Submit only through an established qualifying consortium; otherwise monitor the services created by the funded facility.

title: ERA Research Managers 2027
summary: HORIZON-WIDERA-2027-02-WIDENING-02 is planned for 6 April to 14 September 2027. The allocation is EUR 65 million, with an expected EUR 1.5-2.5 million contribution per project for lasting institutional research-management change at a widening beneficiary.
reality_check: Requires a named experienced external manager without an existing contractual relationship with the beneficiary, at least 50% FTE on site until a permanent leader is appointed by month 36, and limits on existing staff joining the new team. At most half the new team may come from pre-existing contractual relationships. This is not blanket reimbursement of current administration or software.
action_note: Obtain an institutional commitment to the reform, external recruitment and permanent capacity before developing the candidate and project budget.

title: ERA Chairs 2027
summary: HORIZON-WIDERA-2027-02-WIDENING-01 is planned for 6 April to 14 September 2027. The allocation is EUR 175 million, with an expected EUR 1.5-2.5 million per project, typically over five years, for scientific leadership and institutional change.
reality_check: Requires an excellent external scientific leader, a credible team and institutional reform. It is distinct from ERA Research Managers and is not an unrestricted PI research budget; confirm the full personnel rules for the chosen candidate.
action_note: Identify the strategic scientific gap, international candidate and long-term institutional commitments before designing the application.

title: Excellence Hubs 2027
summary: HORIZON-WIDERA-2027-04-WIDENING-01 has been open since 2 September 2026 and closes on 4 March 2027. Expected funding is EUR 1.5-4.5 million for the whole project connecting regional innovation ecosystems.
reality_check: At least two ecosystems in two widening countries are required, each linking research, businesses, public administration and society, including a business with at least two years of turnover. A pair of research institutes alone is insufficient.
action_note: Confirm the regional partners and genuine joint innovation or investment priorities, with a specific UJF scientific or technology role.

title: HORIZON-INFRA-2027-DEV-01-01 - Preparatory Phase of New ESFRI Infrastructures
summary: Opening is planned for 9 March 2027, with a 15 June deadline. Potential UJF role: preparation of a qualifying new European research infrastructure. Topic allocation: EUR 30 million; expected contribution: EUR 1.5-3.5 million per whole project. These are indicative contributions, not guaranteed minimum/maximum grants or the UJF share.
reality_check: Eligibility is restricted to qualifying new ESFRI infrastructures. National membership does not itself qualify a proposal; this is not a routine CANAM equipment upgrade. The UJF budget and complete consortium and cost conditions remain to be established.
action_note: Identify the specific topic and existing European infrastructure partners, document their eligibility and agree a concrete UJF service or technology contribution.

title: HORIZON-INFRA-2027-DEV-01-02 - Integration and Synergies of European Infrastructures
summary: Opening is planned for 9 March 2027, with a 15 June deadline. Potential UJF role: integration of complementary methods and services across European networks. Topic allocation: EUR 20 million; expected contribution: EUR 2-5 million per whole project. These are indicative contributions, not guaranteed minimum/maximum grants or the UJF share.
reality_check: A consortium integrating eligible pan-European infrastructures is needed; confirm the complete eligible infrastructure scope. The UJF budget and complete consortium and cost conditions remain to be established.
action_note: Identify the specific topic and existing European infrastructure partners, document their eligibility and agree a concrete UJF service or technology contribution.

summary: Opening is planned for 9 March 2027, with a 15 June deadline. Potential UJF role: evolution of an infrastructure and its user services. reality_check: Support concerns pan-European infrastructure development and long-term sustainability, not an isolated local equipment purchase. The UJF budget and complete consortium and cost conditions remain to be established.
action_note: Identify the specific topic and existing European infrastructure partners, document their eligibility and agree a concrete UJF service or technology contribution.

title: HORIZON-INFRA-2027-SERV-01-01 - Integrated Access to Research Infrastructures - Pilot
summary: Opening is planned for 9 March 2027, with a 15 June deadline. Potential UJF role: CANAM as an access provider within a European consortium. Topic allocation: EUR 105 million; expected contribution: EUR around 35 million per whole project. These are indicative contributions, not guaranteed minimum/maximum grants or the UJF share.
reality_check: UJF must participate in a qualifying integrated-access consortium; this provider role is different from requesting beamtime as an individual user. The UJF budget and complete consortium and cost conditions remain to be established.

reality_check: The proposal must broaden access and user communities; do not assume a general infrastructure operating subsidy. The UJF budget and complete consortium and cost conditions remain to be established.

title: HORIZON-INFRA-2027-TECH-01-01 - Co-creation of Advanced Research Infrastructure Technologies
summary: Opening is planned for 9 March 2027, with a 15 June deadline. Potential UJF role: detectors, beam diagnostics, control or scientific software developed jointly with infrastructures and industry. Topic allocation: EUR 30 million; expected contribution: EUR 10-15 million per whole project. These are indicative contributions, not guaranteed minimum/maximum grants or the UJF share.
reality_check: At least two different qualifying ESFRI, ERIC or international European research infrastructures must be beneficiaries, with documented status. The RI technology track goes beyond TRL 4; complementary non-RI uses target TRL 3-4. The UJF budget and complete consortium and cost conditions remain to be established.
action_note: Identify the specific topic and existing European infrastructure partners, document their eligibility and agree a concrete UJF service or technology contribution.

title: HORIZON-INFRA-2027-01-EOSC-02 - EOSC Knowledge Valorisation and Industry-Academia Collaboration
summary: Opening is planned for 9 March 2027, with a 15 June deadline. Potential UJF role: research-data reuse and interoperability within a demonstrable EOSC role. Topic allocation: EUR 8 million; expected contribution: EUR 2.5-4 million per whole project. These are indicative contributions, not guaranteed minimum/maximum grants or the UJF share.
reality_check: Confirm the full EOSC scope and applicant eligibility; this is not a general institutional IT grant. The UJF budget and complete consortium and cost conditions remain to be established.

title: Fusion Technologies for the First Fusion Power Plants - Second Call
summary: HORIZON-EURATOM-2027-02-01 is planned to open on 15 April 2027 and close on 4 November 2027. The topic allocation is EUR 45 million, with an expected contribution around EUR 15 million per whole project.
reality_check: The complete second-call scope and conditions have not been verified in this scan. Do not transfer the first call's three technology areas, funding rates or TRL requirements to this separate topic.
action_note: Monitor the specific second-call documentation and assess a potential UJF role only against its own technical and consortium requirements.

action_note: Work with a prepared consortium, obtain the full SRT and confirm the external-partner funding route and submission time before committing UJF resources.

title: RIANA - Transnational Access
summary: Rolling access to RIANA nanoscience facilities where the nanoscale below 100 nm is essential to the project. Access is free; eligible visits may reimburse up to two travellers, with travel up to EUR 300 per person and accommodation up to EUR 100 per person per night against receipts.
reality_check: The PI and majority of the team must work outside the host facility's country, and results must be published. A Czech team using the Czech Tandetron does not meet transnationality. Experiments must take place within 18 months of acceptance; approval is not guaranteed.
action_note: Select the scientific question and an eligible foreign facility, optionally discuss a pre-proposal, then submit the full access request through ARIA.

title: RIANA - Staff Exchanges
summary: Rolling short exchanges for junior or young staff employed by RIANA partner infrastructures, usually around one week. Support covers eligible travel and accommodation up to EUR 1,000. The EUR 23,000 programme total through project month 36 is not a confirmed remaining balance.
reality_check: The host must be outside the applicant's specific RIANA network. Usually one applicant per facility is supported and the applicant must not already be a user of the host. Eligibility and available funds require confirmation.
action_note: Agree a one-page training plan and obtain sending and receiving approvals before requesting support and booking travel.

title: RIANA - Invite an Expert
summary: Rolling support for expert participation in a network meeting, with up to EUR 1,000 as a partial contribution to eligible travel costs. The limit is one supported invitation per network per year, not per institute.
reality_check: This is not full event funding. The network coordinator must submit the request at least six months before the event, subject to approval and available funds.
action_note: Agree the expert and scientific purpose with the network coordinator and plan the request at least six months ahead.

title: AV CR Researchers at Risk - Fourth Round 2027-2029
summary: The fourth Researchers at Risk Fellowship round is announced for January 2027, supporting placements during 2027-2029 with up to 24 months of salary support. No exact opening day, deadline or award amount is established in this scan.
reality_check: Requires a specific eligible at-risk researcher and a credible host and work plan. The announced round is not yet an open application window.
action_note: Assess a candidate and hosting capacity and check the official January announcement for final eligibility, salary rules and dates.

title: CZELO Brussels Internship for AV CR Project Offices
summary: Applications are open from 18 September to 30 October 2026 for the Brussels internship on 12-16 April 2027. Up to ten participants are selected from AV CR project offices; English at least at B2 level is required.
reality_check: All travel and accommodation costs are borne by the sending institute. This is a training opportunity, not a cash grant or a reimbursement from the Academy Office.
action_note: Select an eligible staff member and secure the institutional travel budget before submitting the application.

title: COST SHARP (CA24159) - Hadron Structure and Spectroscopy
summary: SHARP runs from 20 October 2025 to 19 October 2029. Working-group participation can be requested through e-COST; relevant routes include WG1/WG2 for theory and WG4 for instrumentation.
reality_check: Both Czech Management Committee seats are occupied. Working-group entry is separate from national representation and from funded mobility; an active STSM or school funding call was not verified.
action_note: Apply for the scientifically relevant working group and discuss a concrete contribution; confirm any mobility funding separately.

title: COST MLQC4FC (CA24146) - ML and Quantum Computing for Future Colliders
summary: An active network for machine learning and quantum computing in future-collider science, including simulation, reconstruction and physics data. This is not a general institutional or office-AI programme.
reality_check: The full e-COST entry procedure and dates were not verified. A single published Czech Management Committee member is not proof of another vacant seat. A grants page marked as forthcoming is not an open funding call.
action_note: Contact the relevant working group, particularly WG1 for a matching scientific proposal, and confirm participation and any grant procedures separately.

title: COST ICED (CA25144) - Laser-target Supply Chain for Inertial Fusion
summary: ICED runs from 9 September 2026 to 8 September 2030. Potential UJF roles include ion modification, target characterisation and fuel metrology, particularly in WG4/WG5. Working-group applications are available through e-COST.
reality_check: Participation is distinct from a grant award. Confirm national Management Committee availability through the appropriate national process; the main proposer is not automatically the current Action chair. No specific open mobility award was verified.
action_note: Define a target-related measurement or materials contribution, apply to a suitable working group and check future mobility opportunities separately.

title: Horizon Health 2027 - Exposome and Climate-related Health Impacts
summary: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01-ENVHLTH-02 is planned to open on 10 February and close on 13 April 2027. The expected contribution is EUR 10-11 million per whole project. Potential UJF input is exposure reconstruction and isotope-based measurements within an exposome study.
reality_check: Requires an epidemiological and environmental-health consortium with a demonstrated climate-health question. The UJF budget and detailed eligible costs have not been established; analytical capability alone is not enough.
action_note: Identify an appropriate health or environmental coordinator and define a measurable exposure-related work package before developing the consortium budget.

title: Horizon Health 2027 - Predictive Biomarkers and AI-enabled Tools (Topic Summary)
summary: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-02-TOOL-01-two-stage is planned to open on 10 February 2027. Mandatory first-stage proposals are due 13 April; full proposals on 22 September are only for advancing applicants. Expected contribution: EUR 6-8 million per whole project.
reality_check: A clinical partner and validated biomarker or measurement contribution are required. This is not a general AI call. The title here is abbreviated; the full topic scope and UJF-specific cost eligibility remain to be checked.
action_note: Match a validated radiochemical or measurement capability to a clinical use case with an eligible consortium and prepare for the first stage.

title: ERDERA Clinical Trial Call 2026 - Invited Short Proposals Only
summary: Expressions of interest closed on 10 September 2026. Short proposals are due 29 October only for invited or advancing consortia; this is not a new-entry deadline. Funding is coordinated centrally through Fondazione Telethon, not a Czech AZV national allocation.
reality_check: A clinical sponsor and a specific justified clinical-trial role are essential. Czech eligibility does not establish a UJF budget. Limits, costs and rules for adding a participant to an already registered consortium require confirmation.
action_note: Follow only an eligible invited consortium and confirm whether a specific UJF radiochemistry or dosimetry contribution can be included under the existing registration.

title: AV CR Mobility Plus - 2027 Starts, Closed
summary: The Mobility Plus intake for projects starting in 2027 closed on 8 June 2026. The future project start does not mean that a September application window is open.
reality_check: This entry is retained only to distinguish submitted mobility proposals from currently open international cooperation opportunities.
action_note: Follow submitted proposals and any official successor announcement; do not prepare a new application against the closed 2027-start round.
